description: the Atlassian sync-back on a timer (Story 31.4, §6.8 c and e, D9): run `plansync.py sync-back` against the submitting project's root ({project_root}, substituted by jobrun's execute_core) every 10 minutes, pulling each tracked issue's status, its comments and attachments (as links) into _bmad-output/tracking/ and the owner's Confluence pages into kb/confluence/; nothing local is promoted back. A core target, not a skill target: a skill target would be a model session every tick. Shipped undeclared, as evolve-proposals is: the project declares it in .tk-studio/config.yaml jobs and may override the schedule. The run's summary.json names status, counts and newest_comment; the verb commits nothing.
